svg.title: The receiver's own flag against Kshana's alarm
svg.desc: The receiver's own spoofing flag set against Kshana's alarms, from a real run of engine v0.40.0 on a made-up UBX log (200 epochs at 1 Hz). C/N0 falls 20 dB at 80 to 90 s and 120 to 130 s; the receiver flags 120 to 130 s and 160 to 165 s. Of 140 epochs compared after calibration, 11 had both flagging, 6 the receiver only, 11 Kshana only and 112 neither. Neither side is ground truth and agreement is not validation. Advisory: analysis output from a research and engineering tool, not type-approved navigation equipment and not a safety-of-life service.
